about: How the geo ETL writes the rows two region rules depend on (docs/contracts/region.md, Values). GLiM writes each rock type's share of a district twice, as a DistrictGeology row and as the DistrictEnvValue lithology_<code>, so the region reads the geology row and never a value whose variable starts with lithologyTwinPrefix. GLiM rock-type shares and USGS MRDS per-commodity counts are written only where the rock type or commodity occurs, so a state aggregate of a variable starting with the prefix absentMeansZero names for its dataset counts every district of the state holding any value of that dataset, with zero where its row is absent. etl/geo/tests/test_region_rules.py runs the GLiM and MRDS row builders and checks both against this file.
